pages.text: Don't blink. It has already priced your rubies.

pages.title: The Policy
pages.text: Weeping Angels and OreSpawn now share paperwork. The policy has three clauses, all added as data to the angels' own rules: detection, theft and retaliation.$(p)Read the clauses in order. For once in this pack's insurance history, you are the beneficiary.

pages.title: Clause One: Detection
pages.text: The Timey Wimey Detector now pings OreSpawn's teleporting anomalies: Ender Knights, Ender Reapers, the Vortex, and Fairies all register as angel-adjacent physics.$(p)So when the detector starts ticking with no statue in sight, one of Danger's teleporters is working the area. Or there is a statue, and you simply haven't seen it yet. Either way, take the tick seriously.

pages.title: Clause Two: Theft
pages.text: Angels pickpocket: loose rubies and titanium ingots can vanish from your pockets into theirs. The good news is you can get them back. An angel that robbed you is carrying your valuables, which turns a terrifying statue into a walking strongbox.$(p)Stolen rubies change hands a lot out there. See $(l:orespawn_integrations:living_world/structure_treasures)Structure Treasures$() for who else deals in them.

pages.title: Clause Three: Retaliation
pages.text: Angels shrug off nearly every weapon ever made. The short list of exceptions now includes Big Bertha and the Royal Guardian Sword. Ten feet of ruby-edged steel doesn't need to blink. Felling one earns Don't Blink, Bertha.$(p)Both swords also got new moves. See $(l:orespawn_integrations:big_game/weapon_movesets)Weapon Move-Sets$() before you go statue-tipping.
